subject: CALL statement
notes: LANDED (kb/Work PB132): the identifier-target arm now REJECTS any class outside the rule (COBOL1681) where it previously read the category only to set the pointer flag and let a numeric or boolean target fall through to a garbage name-string read at RUN time. Admit side pinned both ways: the program-pointer target (2002/program_pointer) and the dynamic alphanumeric target activating by VALUE at execution time per 14.9.4.4 GR3b (pb132_dynamic_call_target); reject side by the numeric-target negative. Editions: national and program-pointer targets are 2002+ constructs but cannot be DECLARED below 2002, so one screen serves all four.
